scripted_safe_target_candidate_rule: Use the ordered two-sided-corridor offsets fixed by revision 2; provisionally select the first risk/safe pair passing every static gate, then require the same pair to pass the scripted dynamic safety gate without learned ER policy outcomes.
selection_rule: Provisionally choose the first ordered risk candidate passing every non-policy physical, exact-policy-view visibility, and paired-state gate together with the first statically feasible safe-target offset. Freeze the scene only after that pair also passes a scripted dynamic safe-reference gate; do not run or inspect a new ER policy rollout during either selection phase.
